title: How should loadChangeEvidence treat a stale changed-files cache?
context: Nothing writes .paqad/session/changed-files.json any more, so any cache is stale. Today one surviving entry hides every other live edit from the rules-loaded gate and the capability gate. Non-git or base-less repos keep today's behaviour under either option (working-tree status, else none).

options.label: Stop reading the cache; derive changed files from git only (working tree plus committed since merge-base)
Union the surviving cache entries with git (working tree plus committed since base)

rationale: No writer exists, so the cache is dead input; git (working tree + committed since merge-base) is the one honest source. Non-git/base-less repos keep working-tree status, else none.
